Your server and your router write into the tile's log in plain words, and a notification hub sends the messages of every app in your fortress through one set of channels, with quiet hours and a daily summary. Thanks to @Revan335 for the idea in [#3](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/tollroll/issues/3).

## ✨ Added
- **Your server in the log.** Unraid's syslog joins the tile's log, sorted into errors, warnings and info. Lines that matter, such as disk errors, parity checks, the mover, sign-ins or running out of memory, come with one sentence that says what they mean, and a parity check says why it started. Hover a line to see the original, and routine noise folds into one line.
- **Disks that wake up.** When an array or pool disk spins up, the log says which one and what likely woke it: a container, a VM, a network share, the mover, a parity check or a scheduled task. Pick Disks above the log and press Open to see how often each disk woke today and in the last 7 days. TollRoll only reads, so it never wakes a disk itself.
- **The unusual stands out.** A sign-in from a new address, a burst of failed sign-ins, a new plugin, changed settings on the flash drive, a new scheduled task, a share newly open to guests or many files deleted at once get a line of their own. When /var/log is 80% full, the log names the biggest file and who writes it.
- **Your router's log too.** Send it to Unraid's syslog server, and TollRoll watches it for new sign-ins, changed port forwards and firewall rules, intrusion warnings, new devices on your network and a log that goes quiet. It only reads those lines and never connects to the router.
- **A notification hub.** Send messages to Unraid, Apprise, Discord, Gotify, Matrix, ntfy, Slack, email or a webhook. Apps of your fortress that know TollRoll hand their notifications to it, so quiet hours, a daily summary and a level per app apply to all of them. The same message goes out once, and a flood of them waits for the next free slot.
- **The all-clear reaches every channel.** When an app says a problem is over, channels that only take problems hear it too.
- **Messages lead to the right page.** A message can link to a page on your server, and every channel opens it under your server's address.
- **Suggestions.** TollRoll looks at your server and suggests an app of the fortress where one would help, for backups, container updates or the server's health.
- **Everything open in one view.** Open in the tile header lists what each app still needs from you.
- **Plugins that only check now and then** still get their row on the tile.
- **The Help card** offers the TollRoll Discord server beside GitHub.

## 🎨 Design
- **Channels picked from tiles.** Add a channel in a window with a search and the services' logos, then fill in its fields and send a test right there. Every change is saved at once.
- **A real time picker** for the quiet hours and the daily summary: pick the hour and the minute from two lists.
- **Cleaner settings.** Fields have no frames, every button shows its icon, controls stand at the end of their row, open lists show plain rows with a check mark, and the (i) and its bubble look like they do in your other apps.
- **GlimStone 4.5.7.** With TowerTorch, rows, chips, views, options and tabs light in its hover colour, and the chosen view and filter above the log take your accent colour.
- **Without a fortress** the tile header holds only the title and its buttons.

## ⚡ Improved
- **A steadier fortress.** TollRoll keeps listening on a server with a single network interface, a member that already took a new phrase no longer shows as gone, and a member that is just closing no longer locks out a newcomer.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **The gear in the tile header** is as easy to see as the other header buttons with TowerTorch.

## 🌐 Translations
- **Every new text in all 26 languages Unraid offers,** and French readers are addressed with tu.
